answer: The marble counter is kept in inlet and vault exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 43 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker as a result has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 43 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 14 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
